name: BinaryFormatter/RCE
description: BinaryFormatter deserialization — most dangerous .NET formatter. Allows arbitrary object graph deserialization. Present in ASP.NET WebForms, WCF, .NET Remoting.
detection: Magic bytes: 00 01 00 00 00 (NRBF record). Often base64-encoded in POST body or ViewState.
mitigation: Replace with System.Text.Json or Newtonsoft.Json. Enable BinaryFormatter restrictions in .NET 5+.

name: ObjectStateFormatter/RCE
description: ASP.NET ObjectStateFormatter — used for ViewState serialization in WebForms. Exploitable when MAC validation is disabled or key is known.
detection: ViewState parameter in ASP.NET WebForms POST requests. Base64-encoded, starts with /w after decode.
mitigation: Enable ViewState MAC, use HTTPS, rotate machineKey regularly.

name: LosFormatter/RCE
description: ASP.NET LosFormatter (Limited Object Serialization) — lightweight serializer used in older ASP.NET. Wraps ObjectStateFormatter.
detection: Compressed and base64-encoded ViewState or form fields in legacy ASP.NET apps.
mitigation: Migrate to ASP.NET Core. Enable ViewState MAC.

name: SoapFormatter/RCE
description: SoapFormatter — SOAP-based XML serializer. Deprecated but present in legacy WCF/ASMX services.
detection: SOAP XML request/response with type attributes. Look for __type or type annotations.
mitigation: Migrate to WCF with DataContractSerializer or REST APIs.

name: XmlSerializer/TypeConfuse
description: XmlSerializer type confusion via xsi:type attribute injection. Requires attacker-controlled Type parameter.
detection: XML POST body with xsi:type attributes pointing to arbitrary types.
mitigation: Validate allowed types before deserialization. Use DataContractSerializer with known types list.

name: DataContractSerializer/TypeConfuse
description: DataContractSerializer with NetDataContractSerializer — exploitable when resolving arbitrary types. Common in WCF services.
detection: WCF SOAP endpoints with NetDataContractSerializer. Look for __type in JSON or type attribute in XML.
mitigation: Use known types list. Avoid NetDataContractSerializer.

name: Json.NET/TypeNameHandling
description: Newtonsoft.Json RCE when TypeNameHandling.Auto or TypeNameHandling.All is enabled. Allows injecting arbitrary .NET types via $type property.
detection: $type JSON property in deserialization payload. Commonly seen in ASP.NET APIs accepting generic object types.
mitigation: Set TypeNameHandling = TypeNameHandling.None. Use SerializationBinder to whitelist types.

name: ViewState/MachineKeyRCE
description: ViewState RCE via known machineKey. If machineKey is leaked (web.config exposure, default key), attacker can forge malicious ViewState triggering BinaryFormatter deserialization.
detection: __VIEWSTATE parameter in ASP.NET WebForms POST. Check for ViewStateMac=false or known machineKey from GitHub/Shodan leaks.
mitigation: Use unique random machineKey. Never disable ViewState MAC. Upgrade to ASP.NET Core.

name: TypeDescriptor/RCE
description: TypeDescriptor.GetConverter exploitation — bypasses SerializationBinder via type conversion abuse.
detection: Generic RCE gadget in any .NET 4.x application using BinaryFormatter.

name: ActivitySurrogateSelector/RCE
description: ActivitySurrogateSelector gadget — bypasses BinaryFormatter blocklists in .NET 4.8 and earlier.
detection: Use when standard gadgets are blocked by custom serialization binders.
mitigation: Apply KB4341860 hotfix or upgrade to .NET 5+.

name: XAML/BamlRCE
description: XAML deserialization via XamlReader.Parse() — arbitrary .NET type instantiation through XAML markup injection.
detection: Applications accepting XAML or BAML input. WPF applications with custom XAML loading.
mitigation: Never deserialize untrusted XAML. Use read-only XamlSchemaContext.

name: ResourceReader/RCE
description: ResourceReader deserialization via .resources file injection. Affects applications dynamically loading resource files.
detection: Applications loading .resx files from user-controlled paths.
mitigation: Validate and restrict resource file sources.

name: WCF/NetDataContractSerializer
description: WCF services using NetDataContractSerializer — allows arbitrary type injection.
detection: WCF endpoints exposing netTcpBinding or wsHttpBinding with NetDataContractSerializer.
mitigation: Migrate to DataContractSerializer with known types.
